subtitle: Cross-reading of September 20, 2026, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT (00:47 UTC on Sep 21), with the presidential book at USD 152.02M. AFOS certification is done contract by contract, and in this round THREE of the five watched contracts received a new price: outright winner, third place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and impeachment at the Supreme Court. The contracts for second place in the first round and for a Senate majority did not receive a new price, and they go live with the range of the recorded readings, which is a property of the book and is explained in the field itself. Polls: Datafolha and Futura/100% Cidades of Sep 17, the two most recent national polls with numbers in a primary source.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 41.50% (vol USD 11.45M accumulated) in the outright winner contract, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, up 1.00pp against the 40.50% confirmed on Sep 19. POLL: 39% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in the Datafolha poll of Sep 17 and 38.3% in Futura/100% Cidades. The price rises and he keeps losing ground to Flávio, because Flávio rose almost twice as much.
fortes: Leads the first round in both national polls of Sep 17, 39% to 36% at Datafolha and 38.3% to 37.7% at Futura/100% Cidades, and in both the distance fits inside two margins.
He also leads Datafolha's simulated [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) of Sep 17, 46% to 44%, within the margin.
The volume of his contract in the winner book is USD 11.45M accumulated, the larger of the two names contesting the price, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT.
fracos: In the outright winner contract he stands at 41.50% against 58.65% for Flávio, a gap of 17.15pp, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT.
That gap is the widest of the 155 days in which the recorded series has both sides, since April 14, 2026, measured at daily closes. The previous high was 16.30pp, at the close of Sep 19.
The climb is recent and continuous: the gap was 2.10pp at the close of Sep 12 and passed through 6.40pp on Sep 14, 9.80pp on Sep 16 and 14.00pp on Sep 18.
candidates.analise: In the outright winner contract Lula rose 1.00pp, from 40.50% to 41.50% (vol USD 11.45M accumulated), reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT. His price rose and even so the gap against Flávio widened, because Flávio rose 1.90pp over the same interval. In the polls the picture is the opposite of the price: he leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in the two national polls of Sep 17 and leads Datafolha's simulated [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), always within margin. AFOS does not say which of the two universes is right. It says they have been pointing in different directions for a week, and that the distance between them grew every day since Sep 12.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 58.65% (vol USD 11.15M accumulated) in the outright winner contract, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, up 1.90pp against the 56.75% confirmed on Sep 19. POLL: 36% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in the Datafolha poll of Sep 17 and 37.7% in Futura/100% Cidades, behind Lula in both and within two margins.
fortes: 58.65% in the outright winner contract (vol USD 11.15M accumulated), up 1.90pp in 24 hours, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT.
The 17.15pp gap in his favour is the widest of the 155 days in which the recorded series has both sides, since April 14, 2026, measured at daily closes.
In the second place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he stands at 72.00%, and across the readings recorded on Sep 19 that contract ranged from 69.00% to 73.50%.
fracos: He loses the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in the two national polls of Sep 17, 36% to 39% in Datafolha and 37.7% to 38.3% in Futura/100% Cidades.
He loses Datafolha's simulated [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) of Sep 17, 44% to 46%, within the margin.

The volume of his contract in the winner book, USD 11.15M accumulated, is smaller than Lula’s, USD 11.45M, and smaller than Renan Santos’s, USD 13.89M, and than Tarcísio de Freitas’s, USD 14.08M, which is the largest in the book. High volume measures accumulated interest, not probability now.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro rose 1.90pp in the outright winner contract, from 56.75% to 58.65% (vol USD 11.15M accumulated), reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT. It was the largest single day rise among the watched contracts in this round, and it is what widens the gap, not a fall by Lula, who in fact rose 1.00pp. In the two national polls of Sep 17 he appears behind in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and behind in the simulated [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), both times within margin. The contrast between price and poll is the fact of the panel today, and it is larger than on any day in the recorded series.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.05% in the outright winner contract and 32.55% (vol USD 237 thousand accumulated) in the third place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, down 3.80pp in the third place contract against the 36.35% of Sep 19. POLL: 6% in the first round in the Datafolha poll of Sep 17 and 6.5% in Futura/100% Cidades, third in both.
fortes: He is third in both national polls of Sep 17, 6% at Datafolha and 6.5% at Futura/100% Cidades, ahead of Renan Santos in both.
At Datafolha his rejection is 9%, the lowest among the six names with 2% or more of voting intention.
fracos: Falls 4.65pp in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, to 36.35%, the largest fall of any contract on the panel in this round, and sits 14.65pp behind Renan Santos, against 8.00pp on 18/Sep.
In the winner contract he stands at 0.15%, and the lowest value in the recorded readings of his series is 0.10%.

The polls and the book disagree on the order of the third way, and the distance between them doubled: both firms put him ahead of Renan Santos, and the third-place contract pays 14.65pp more on Renan.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury fell 3.80pp in the third place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), from 36.35% to 32.55% (vol USD 237 thousand accumulated), reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT. It was the largest fall among the contracts that received a new price in this round. In the polls he remains third in the two national polls of Sep 17, with 6% in Datafolha and 6.5% in Futura/100% Cidades, ahead of Renan Santos in both. The price moved against him and the poll did not move, because there is no new national poll since Sep 17.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.85% (vol USD 13.89M accumulated) in the outright winner contract and 52.50% (vol USD 355 thousand accumulated) in the third place contract, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, up 1.50pp in the third place one. POLL: 3% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in the Datafolha poll of Sep 17 and 3.4% in Futura/100% Cidades, behind Augusto Cury in both. The third place price says the opposite of the poll, and it is the cleanest divergence on the panel today.
fortes: Rises 2.00pp in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, to 51.00%, and opens 14.65pp over Augusto Cury, against 8.00pp on 18/Sep.
His is the contract with the largest accumulated volume in the second and third-place books of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), USD 1.34M and USD 349 thousand.
He filed a petition at the Superior Electoral Court against the Bolsa Família increase on Sep 17, and the rapporteur drawn was André Mendonça.
fracos: In the winner contract he falls 0.10pp, to 0.85%, and sits within 0.05pp of the lowest value in the recorded readings of his series.
In the two national polls of Sep 17 he stands behind Augusto Cury, 3% to 6% at Datafolha and 3.4% to 6.5% at Futura/100% Cidades.
At Datafolha his rejection is 15%, the third highest in the poll, behind only Lula's and Flávio Bolsonaro's.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos rose 1.50pp in the third place contract, from 51.00% to 52.50% (vol USD 355 thousand accumulated), reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, and it is the largest volume in that book. In the outright winner contract he stands at 0.85%, with USD 13.89M accumulated, the second largest volume in the whole presidential book. In the two national polls of Sep 17 he appears behind Augusto Cury, 3% to 6% in Datafolha and 3.4% to 6.5% in Futura. The market puts him first in the third place contract and the poll puts him fourth. It is the cleanest divergence on the panel, because it does not depend on margin: they are different positions, not close numbers.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado 0.05% in the outright winner contract and 11.50% in the third place one, Romeu Zema 0.15% and 1.25% in the third place one, up 0.90pp, and Fernando Haddad 0.05%, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT. POLL: Caiado 4% and Zema 2% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in the Datafolha poll of Sep 17.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with prices from the reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT and polls from Datafolha and Futura/100% Cidades of Sep 17, which remain the most recent.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the THIRD PLACE contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he is parked at 11.50%, in a book of USD 138 thousand. He has 4% in the first round in Datafolha and 4.5% in Futura/100% Cidades, both from Sep 17.
caiado.fortes: Rises 1.00pp in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, to 11.50%, and is the only one of the three to gain price in this round. He is fourth in both national polls of 17/Sep, with 4% at Datafolha and 4.5% at Futura/100% Cidades, and holds third position in the third-place book.
caiado.fracos: In the winner contract he remains at 0.05%, below the lowest value ever recorded in his series, 0.10% on 17/Sep. Neither firm tests him in a runoff pair, and no new national poll has come out since 17/Sep.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, at the floor of the book. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and the two national polls of Sep 17 do not test him in a [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in this reading, so there is no movement to explain, and the top of his series in the winner contract is 7.60%, on May 26, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by the two national polls of 17/Sep, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round. His winner contract holds USD 7.54M, a larger volume than Augusto Cury's, who is measured in the polls and holds USD 4.98M.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.15% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, still below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the THIRD PLACE contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 0.90pp, to 1.25%, which is his only move in this round. He has 2% in the first round in Datafolha and 1.0% in Futura/100% Cidades.
zema.fortes: He remains at 0.15% in the winner contract, above the floor of his series, 0.10% on 17/Sep, even though the value stays below the 0.5% cut the panel uses to treat a thin price as noise.
zema.fracos: He did not move in either contract in this round and neither national poll of 17/Sep tests him in a [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pair. The top of his series in the winner contract is 12.00%, on 13/May.

candidates.analise: Ronaldo Caiado stands at 0.05% in the outright winner contract and 11.50% in the third place one, and Romeu Zema at 0.15% and 1.25% in the third place one, up 0.90pp, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT. In the polls of Sep 17, Caiado has 4% in Datafolha and 4.5% in Futura, and Zema has 2% and 1.0%. Fernando Haddad remains at 0.05% in the outright winner contract and is not tested in the two national polls.
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado rises 1.00pp in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, to 11.50%, with USD 138 thousand accumulated, and holds third position in that book.
At Datafolha, Ronaldo Caiado has 4% in the first round and a rejection of 13%, below Renan Santos's and Romeu Zema's.
fracos: Ronaldo Caiado remains at 0.05% in the winner contract, below the lowest value in the recorded readings of his series, 0.10% on 17/Sep, and Romeu Zema and Fernando Haddad did not move in any contract.
Romeu Zema falls 0.50pp in the third-place contract, to 0.35%, and has 2% at Datafolha and 1.0% at Futura/100% Cidades.
Fernando Haddad remains at 0.05% in the winner contract and is not tested in the first round by either of the two national polls of Sep 17.

quadroComparativo.p: At Datafolha of Sep 17 (field Sep 15 to 16, in person, 2,002 interviews, margin of 2.0pp) he has 39% in the first round, ahead, and wins the runoff 46% to 44%. At Futura/100% Cidades of the same day (field Sep 11 to 15, phone, 2,000 interviews, margin of 2.2pp) he has 38.3% in the first round and loses the runoff 43.7% to 48.1%.
quadroComparativo.m: 41.50% (vol USD 11.45M accumulated) in the outright winner contract, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, up 1.00pp
quadroComparativo.t: falls 2.00pp and opens the gap on his own, from 14.00pp to 16.25pp, because the opponent rose only 0.25pp
quadroComparativo.s: Datafolha of Sep 17 measures 48% government approval against 50% disapproval, and Futura/100% Cidades of the same day measures 44.1% against 53.1%. That is 3.9 points of difference on approval between two firms that published on the same day, and the panel does not read them as a series.

quadroComparativo.p: 36% in the first round and 44% in the runoff against Lula's 46% at Datafolha of Sep 17, inside two margins. At Futura/100% Cidades of the same day he has 37.7% in the first round and wins the runoff 48.1% to 43.7%, outside two margins.
quadroComparativo.m: 58.65% (vol USD 11.15M accumulated) in the outright winner contract, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, up 1.90pp
quadroComparativo.t: rises 0.25pp in the winner book and 5.00pp in the second-place one, and the gap reaches 16.25pp, the largest since 14/Apr
quadroComparativo.s: The two national polls of Sep 17 disagree on the SIGN of the runoff against Lula, not only on the magnitude: Datafolha has him 2 points behind and Futura 4.4 points ahead. The methods differ, in person and phone, and so do the field windows.

quadroComparativo.p: 6% in the first round at Datafolha of Sep 17 and 6.5% at Futura/100% Cidades, third in both and ahead of Renan Santos.
quadroComparativo.m: 0.05% in the outright winner contract and 32.55% (vol USD 237 thousand accumulated) in the third place one, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, down 3.80pp
quadroComparativo.t: largest fall of the day in the third way and the distance to Renan Santos almost doubles, from 8.00pp to 14.65pp
quadroComparativo.s: It is the most direct cross of the round: the two polls put him ahead of Renan Santos in the third way and the third-place contract pays more on Renan, with the distance growing.

quadroComparativo.p: 3% in the first round at Datafolha of Sep 17 and 3.4% at Futura/100% Cidades, behind Augusto Cury in both.
quadroComparativo.m: 0.85% (vol USD 13.89M accumulated) in the outright winner contract and 52.50% (vol USD 355 thousand accumulated) in the third place one, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, up 1.50pp
quadroComparativo.t: rises 2.00pp in the third-place book and opens 14.65pp over Cury, and gives up 0.10pp in the winner one, close to the floor
quadroComparativo.s: His winner contract is the second largest by accumulated volume in the presidential book, USD 13.78M, behind only Tarcísio de Freitas', and it pays 0.85%: volume measures interest accumulated since opening, not probability now.

quadroComparativo.p: 4% in the first round at Datafolha of Sep 17 and 4.5% at Futura/100% Cidades, fourth in both.
quadroComparativo.m: 0.05% in the outright winner contract and 11.50% in the third place one, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT
quadroComparativo.t: rises 1.00pp in the third-place book and sits below the recorded floor in the winner one
quadroComparativo.s: At Datafolha his rejection is 13%, lower than Renan Santos's, at 15%, and Romeu Zema's, at 14%, and even so he stands behind both in one of the instruments.

quadroComparativo.p: 2% in the first round at Datafolha of Sep 17 and 1.0% at Futura/100% Cidades.
quadroComparativo.m: 0.15% in the outright winner contract and 1.25% in the third place one, reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, up 0.90pp
quadroComparativo.t: unchanged in both contracts, at 0.15% in the winner one and 0.35% in the third-place one
quadroComparativo.s: Neither of the two national polls of Sep 17 tests him in a runoff pair, so in this round he only has the first-round number.

cruzamento: THE OUTRIGHT WINNER GAP WIDENED FROM 16.25pp TO 17.15pp, AND THIS TIME BOTH ROSE: Flávio Bolsonaro went from 56.75% to 58.65% (vol USD 11.15M accumulated) and Lula went from 40.50% to 41.50% (vol USD 11.45M accumulated), reading confirmed on Sep 20, 9:47 PM BRT, against the price confirmed on Sep 19, 7:20 PM BRT. What widened the gap was Flávio's rise, almost twice Lula's, and not a fall. That 17.15pp gap is the widest of the 155 days in which the recorded series has both sides, since April 14, 2026, measured at daily closes. The previous high was 16.30pp, at the close of Sep 19. The climb spans eight days: 2.10pp on Sep 12, 6.40pp on Sep 14, 9.80pp on Sep 16, 14.00pp on Sep 18 and 16.30pp on Sep 19. On the other side, the two national polls of Sep 17 put Lula ahead in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and ahead in Datafolha's simulated [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), always within margin, and there is no new national poll with numbers in a primary source since then. So what grew was not the divergence between two new numbers: it was the price moving while the poll stood still. In third place in the first round the market again inverted the order of the poll, with Renan Santos at 52.50% and Augusto Cury at 32.55%, when the poll puts Cury third and Renan fourth. The impeachment contract at the Supreme Court stands at 4.40% (vol USD 92 thousand accumulated) and gave back 0.15pp, on a day when the subject dominated the press: a video published on Sep 20 shows Justice Alexandre de Moraes and his wife landing from a jet belonging to a company that had Daniel Vorcaro as a partner, and the flight is from August 22, 2025. The price did not react.
